summary.claim: offline ideal energy quadrature only; not live body prediction, calibration, promotion or full I10 acceptance

limits: Counterfactual future PCM is an offline energy target; not a live forecast or observed training input.
Own energy is the center-interpolated 10 ms PCM mean-square curve, not an instantaneous sample square or a fitted active-body predictor.
External fields are declared independent synthetic energy conditions; not heard bus mixture or validated perceptual masking.
Rank counts are separate energy-column orders, not full consequence utility or the final action policy.
All buses and routed-away silence are retained; this makes overlap and audibility denominators different.
Gauss order-doubling agreement is a numerical convergence check, not an analytic error bound.
No accuracy acceptance threshold or live grid change was selected from these results.
The live 16-point diagnostic now reports continuous_support separately; overlap and audibility are not connected to action.
